marta: quick heads-up — ran a 3-way smoke across Llama2-13B/mistralx-7b/gemma-10b int4 and seeing odd longctx repeats on mistralx variant

samir: what pattern? repeated token ngrams or drifted logits?

marta: short repeats at ~1k tokens, mostly after a name entity. logits look fine locally but rotary phase correlations drop on head 5

jia: could be rotary scaling mismatch + vocab aliasing from tokenizer conversion. did you use our standard tokenmap converter?

marta: yeah used tokenmap-v2, but I noticed mismatch in rotary_index_map for gemma vs mistralx. mapping shows head offset +2 for some odd even/odd heads

noah: can you paste the quick log snippet?

marta: ```
[rotary-sniff] model=mistralx-7b quant=int4 head=5 phase_corr=0.812 -> baseline 0.995 delta=-0.183
[rotary-sniff] model=gemma-10b   quant=int4 head=5 phase_corr=0.992 -> baseline 0.996 delta=-0.004
[rotary-sniff] model=llama2-13b  quant=int4 head=5 phase_corr=0.998 -> baseline 1.000 delta=-0.002
```

samir: wow head 5 delta -0.18 is large. maybe our rotary scale factor (alpha) normalization is being truncated during int4 kernel fusion

jia: or the token ids after conversion have subtle remappings (e.g., soft-hyphen / ZWJ) that push the KV cache alignment. Could reproduce with deterministic prompt?

marta: Yea I made a tiny repro prompt: "Alice met Bob at 11pm, then Alice said" repeated 40x to trigger longctx. Repro attached in gist: https://rdrw/gists/rotary-sniff-17688

noah: next steps? quick experiments: 1) run same model with fp16 runtime (no quant) 2) run mistralx-int4 but with rotary_scale override=1.0 3) run tokenmap-v1 vs v2 to see vocab aliasing

marta: started fp16 run — looks clean (no repeats). starting override run now.

ciro-bot: deploy-check triggered for "mistralx-int4-rotary-override" on staging-3

marta: override run reduces delta to -0.06 and repeats reduce but not gone. tokenmap-v1 -> still repeats but slightly different boundary

samir: that suggests two issues: quantized kernel scaling + token id mapping. Could do a fast patch: when loading int4 kernels, apply per-head float scaling correction from calibration table (simple linear multiplier) and add a tokenmap audit that flags soft-hyphens/zwj canonical collisions

jia: I have a tiny patch for the loader that rescales rotary sin/cos precompute by a headwise multiplier. want me to push as hotfix to the int4 branch?

marta: please. also add a smoke that runs the 3-way prompt with 2 variants (v1/v2 tokenmap) and fails on >1.5% prefix repeat rate

noah: i'll wire the smoke into the internal bench harness and run overnight across our dedicated pool. If it passes, we can flip quant profile for mistralx-7b in the model catalog

samir: note for release notes: mention "int4 rotary-scale calibration" and "tokenmap audit for invisible chars" so solutions engineering knows the mitigation path

marta: thanks — pushing results + logs to slack thread when hotfix lands

jia: ping me once bench finishes, I'll prepare a minimal reproduction testcase for the eval dashboards

noah: ok tracking in the ticket: INF-3268 (three-way rotary + vocab sniff). linking after ci runs

marta: :thumbsup:
